title: hilleria secunda
intro: Hilleria secunda, commonly known as the 'False Garlic', is a plant species that belongs to the family Lamiaceae. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Hilleria secunda include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
